title: The light was the same
entry: The light came in sideways around five, the way it still does. I did not know I would need this page a year later. I only knew the paper looked older than it was.

title: The same August light
entry: The light came in sideways around five, the way it still does. I did not know I would need this page a year later. I only knew the paper looked older than it was. Keep this for the next August morning.

title: Started thinking about it
entry: Started thinking about the project properly, filling half a page with arrows that only make sense to me. A beginning is just permission to be bad at something for a while.

title: Dinner on the balcony
entry: We ate outside because the kitchen was too warm and stayed there long after the food was gone. Someone laughed so hard the candle went out. I want to keep the sound of that, exactly that.

title: Worked on the project
entry: A slow, ordinary day of work on the project. Broke the hard part into four smaller parts and finished two of them. Ate dinner standing up, which I would like to stop doing.

title: A letter I did not send
entry: I wrote three pages to someone who is not going to read them and then folded the pages into the back of this book. It helped more than I expected. Some things only need to be said, not delivered.

title: Rain, all afternoon
entry: It rained from noon until dark. I made too much tea and read on the floor near the window because that is where the sound was best. Nothing happened, which I think was the point of the day.

title: Project finally finished
entry: The project is finished and I keep opening it to look at it, the way you keep touching a tooth that stopped hurting. Two months of small evenings. I want to remember that the boring middle part was where all of it actually happened.

title: Productive Sunday
entry: Today I finally cleared the desk. Not the whole room, just the desk, but it felt like moving a piece of furniture out of my chest. I wrote for an hour without checking anything. The light came in sideways around five and made the paper look older than it is.
